targets.review_note: Build one suffix automaton over all names separated by a character outside a-z. Every letter end position carries its source-name identity and the length available since the latest separator. Propagate end-position ownership through suffix links, using distinct states for no owner, one owner, and multiple owners. A state belonging to one name contributes the represented substring lengths above its suffix-link length, capped by a separator-free suffix length. This counts distinct substrings once, rejects shared substrings including duplicate names, and excludes all cross-name substrings.

targets.review_note: Each forbidden parallelogram is a four-layer path: odd-even horizontal neighbor, important even-even tent, even-odd vertical neighbor, and odd-odd horizontal neighbor of that tent. These choices represent all eight allowed local patterns. Split every tent into an in/out edge with its removal weight and connect geometric layer transitions with capacity greater than the total weight. A minimum source-sink vertex cut removes every forbidden path at minimum total weight; subtract from the total. Negative coordinates use parity consistently and absent neighbor tents introduce no edges.
